faceDesignRationale: Spherical body supports soft medium-width cheeks and rounded jaw. Large rounded eye openings express sensitivity without juvenile proportions. The broad simple mouth becomes a wider adult lip line; short rounded eyebrows and a rounded human nose harmonize with the soft silhouette. Keep natural adult twenties proportions and human facial anatomy.
planning_decision: Freeze comparison at Shedinja, Ninjask and Starly. Lake dock seated twist/full body, kitchen leaning-forward/waist-up and front/three-quarter ukulele have no repeated direction/frame pair. Seated twist and leaning forward are unused among their cuts. The source-influence multiset balanced/balanced/strong differs from all three; only the kitchen shares a full axis triple with one comparison cut.
faceComparison: Compared actual Ninjask, Starly and Shedinja anchors. Whismur has fuller round cheeks, large round level eyes, a soft round nose tip and broader open smile; Ninjask has a long tapered lower face, Starly sharper narrow eyes and thin lips, Shedinja downturned heavy-lidded eyes and fine restrained mouth. Identity remains adult twenties.
finalFacePrompt: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): softly rounded face, balanced length, medium width; soft rounded jaw; open rounded eyes, large size, level outer corners, average spacing; short rounded brows; rounded soft tip nose; wide mouth.
